tasks.title: Remove the lead and runner wake machinery
tasks.description:
Problem

A central scheduler wakes lead and runner sessions. pstack gives each session its own loop.

Decision

Each lead owns its loop. Remove the central wake timers.

Fix

  1. Tell each named lead before removal.

  2. Each lead arms its own watcher and fallback.

  3. Disable and delete the listed units and the hooks tunnel.

Risk

A lead with no loop goes quiet. Its board shows that.

Done when

  • The audit rerun shows none of these items.

  • Proof is on this ticket.
